title: The Placement Flow
summary: The flow from job request to execution involves finding an eligible node, verifying capabilities, and binding the implementation via Runtime Reference.
why: Ensures the total chain of authority (WLU -> Allocator -> Node Profile -> Runtime Reference) is satisfied before execution begins.
invariants: WLU remains the work/capacity admission authority.
Queue Fabric remains the transport authority.
API Client v0.2 remains authoritative for API egress-session allocation after general node placement.
Hard eligibility (Allocator) -> Capabilities (Node Profile) -> Location Binding (Runtime Reference).
